title: Inter 1-0 Shakhtar: Martinez won it, not Carlos Augusto
caption: Inter beat Shakhtar Donetsk 1-0 with ten men, and Josep Martinez won it as much as Carlos Augusto did. Carlos Augusto scored in the 77th, Bastoni was sent off in the 68th for two yellows in two minutes, and Martinez saved twice in the 88th, per Inter.it. Corriere dello Sport says four players miss Fiorentina on Sunday, with Lautaro Martinez not expected back before the break.
